lines.zh: 我甩着手臂，缓步走过来。
lines.en: Swinging my arms, I stroll over.
I take this path every day.
The sand shifts under my feet.
I take a slow turn around the grounds.
My steps are light — that came from practice.
I work my shoulders as I walk.

lines.zh: 这里风沙大，睁眼都费劲。
lines.en: The dust here makes it hard to keep my eyes open.

lines.zh: 我走到你旁边，停了一下。
lines.en: I walk up beside you and pause.
I tend to walk on the outside.
Plant each step; do not rush.
I round the tree and come back out.
This stretch is not far.
I brush the dust off my trousers.
Slow is fine; wrong is not.
I lean on a rock, eyes half shut.
What was I supposed to train today?
I scratch the back of my neck.
The sun is a bit strong.
Arms folded, I look into the distance.
The calluses on my hands have thickened.
I stretch my back a little.

lines.zh: 安静的时候反而想练拳。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I want to punch something.
Wind blows sand in my face.
I count the pebbles on the ground.
Standing like this makes my back ache.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，赶紧收住。
lines.en: I yawn and quickly cut it short.
I push my hair back with one hand.
Someone is calling in the distance; I do not answer.
Want to learn something? Stand properly first.
Your stance is still a bit off.

lines.zh: 我当年也是从零开始的。
lines.en: I started from nothing too, you know.
Do not fear looking foolish; fear not training.
Watch my posture — keep the elbow in.

lines.zh: 要练就认真，别糊弄自己。
lines.en: If you train, train honestly.

lines.zh: 我笑着看你，其实在看你脚下。
lines.en: I smile at you but I am watching your feet.
Your hands are too high.

lines.zh: 练拳先练腿，站稳了再说。
lines.en: Legs first; stand firm before anything else.
I am not the strongest, but I do train.
Rest when tired; do not force it.

lines.zh: 你比我刚来的时候强点。
lines.en: You are a bit better than I was at the start.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的脸，看我的手。
lines.en: Do not stare at my face; watch my hands.
Say what you mean; do not circle around it.
I think I know what you want to ask.
One round with me and you will understand.
Ow — that actually hurts.
I step back and steady my stance.

lines.zh: 这点擦伤，教不了你什么。
lines.en: A scrape like this teaches you nothing.
Even a master takes hits.
It hurts, but I still stand here to teach.
I rub the spot that was hit.
Pain or not, my stance holds.
You strike quickly.
Blood tastes of salt. Normal.
I smile and let out a breath.

lines.zh: 有吃的？那我就不客气了。
lines.en: Food? Then I shall not stand on ceremony.

lines.zh: 放在这儿，我边吃边听你说。
lines.en: Set it here; I will eat while you talk.
This is not bad. Who made it?
It tastes better after training.
Two bites and this bun is gone.
Do not just watch me eat; have some.
A full stomach helps you take a hit.
Just leave me half.
Is this an apprentice's gift?
Fine. I owe you one.
Whoa — steady there.
You bumped me and I nearly lost my footing.
No rush; the path is wide enough.
I put a hand out to steady you.
This spot is narrow to begin with.
Let us both take a step back.
My frame is not the sturdiest.
I am a master, not a punching bag.
You are stronger than you look.
I smile and yield half a step.
Come, I will train with you.
Do not fear the pain; I am holding back.
Punch like this — let the waist follow.

lines.zh: 你进步得比我预想的快。
lines.en: You improve faster than I expected.
Ten more, then we stop.
Catch your breath; have some water.
Martial training cannot be hurried.
I will do it alongside you.
That one was well struck.
Come again tomorrow. Do not slack off.
I'll hold what you dropped.
Whose is this?
Decent weight. Not bad.
I never got used to these.
If it is useful, keep it.
This rock will do for practice.
I pat the dirt off it.
Put your things away; do not litter.
Where is my glove? Lost again.
Hold it tight; do not drop it twice.
Let us have a little spar, then.
I have seen your footwork.

lines.zh: 别用力过猛，容易伤自己。
lines.en: Do not overdo it; you will hurt yourself.
I will be your opponent.
I will take this round seriously.
Ready? Here I come.
You strike first; I will answer.
Do not only guard your head.
Your rhythm is interesting this time.
Do not panic, and do not shut your eyes.

lines.zh: 我看着你的脚，不看拳头。
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your fists.
You dip your shoulder before punching.
Your right footstep is too light.
Do not hold your breath.
I step back half a pace to reset.
You have used that twice now.
Do not lift the elbow so high.

lines.zh: 我还没使劲，你就要退了。
lines.en: I have hardly pushed and you are already giving ground.
Your weight is drifting left.
Hold up; let us talk again.
This punch — remember the angle.
I only tapped you.
Stand firm; do not fall.
Your guard went slack.
That one was not heavy.
Turn the waist; watch mine.
I pulled it, or you would be flying.
Again, just like that.
Wolf Fang Fist. Brace yourself.
Not bad at all. Keep going.
Oh — there you are.
I have been waiting here a while.
The sand makes it hard to keep your eyes open.
If you want to train, now is the time.
I just finished loosening up.
The wind is strong here; stand behind me.
I raise a hand in greeting.
Do not be stiff. Sit anywhere.
Nice weather today.
I saw you coming a while ago.
There is a hole burned in my sleeve.
I landed badly and twisted my ankle.
I choke on water and paddle hard.
The blast left my ears ringing.
Something is stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这股怪劲从骨头里往外钻。
lines.en: That strange force works out from my bones.

lines.zh: 雅木茶也有饿肚子的时候。
lines.en: Even Yamcha gets hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我头发都立起来了。
lines.en: The lightning struck and my hair stood on end.
Nothing underfoot; I am falling.
